denominators.cpu: Last sampled process CPU, not exact final CPU; original restarted formal jobs are not summed into a campaign total.
denominators.d_improved_decisions: Count of D improvement decisions; removing one repeated scorer per decision is a call-count upper bound, not a measured time saving.
denominators.engineering_profile: Two roots at formal per-root budgets, engineering instrumentation, workers=2 on E-cores 16-17; not the formal campaign.
denominators.fast_check: Four selected roots on shared E-cores; not a representative speed or efficacy estimate.
denominators.profile_coverage: SAMPLE includes redeterminization clones; explicit CLONE=0 does not mean no cloning. Eval-world sampling bypasses SAMPLE. Some canonicalization/child-key/tree selection lies outside CANON/TREE wrappers. Reset before E omits replay and initial root scoring; timer overhead is unqualified.
denominators.profile_inference: Nested policy scoring/observation/tensor/forward/action work inside timed choose; D direct improvement scores sit outside this timer.
denominators.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; descriptive only, no uncertainty intervals.
denominators.root_wall: Sum of per-root elapsed times; overlapping parallel roots mean this is not campaign elapsed time or CPU time.
denominators.whole_selection_ms_per_inference_call: Entire selection wall divided by call count, not measured neural-network latency.

code.profile: release, lto thin, codegen-units 1, default target-cpu

scope: Existing terminal Stage 4a artifacts only; no new games, outcome analysis, or CP7.
